metadata.description: Short project prefix — drives RG names and resource naming.
Primary location for RGs and most resources. Override if AOAI region constraint forces a move.
Entra ID objectIds of team members. Required for RBAC. Resolve via `az ad user show --id <upn> --query id`.
Entra ID objectId of the designated Owner (subset of memberObjectIds).
Monthly budget ceiling in USD. Alert fires at 80% and 100%.
Email(s) to notify on budget threshold breach.
Common tags applied to every RG and resource.
Environment label (dev|prod) — drives resource naming + index suffix.
Existing Key Vault name to publish dialogue-delta secrets into.
Feature tag applied to dialogue-delta-formalization resources.

properties.notes: Shared resources — delete only via explicit teardown runbook.

metadata.description: Policy enforcement mode. Use DoNotEnforce on first provision (avoids RequestDisallowedByPolicy race against Storage creation), then flip to Default after the shared resources land.
Container Apps Environment resource ID (from shared.bicep).
Placeholder container image. Real images are pushed by azd / CI.
App Insights connection string for OTEL.
Principal IDs (Container Apps / Foundry MI) that need Key Vault Secrets User role.
Cosmos endpoint to publish as non-secret config (kept here for symmetry).
Primary location (must be a Foundry-preview region; swedencentral).
Storage account ID for the hub.
Key Vault ID for the hub.
App Insights ID for the hub (optional).
